English: They also attached radio transmitters to 14 of the tortoises.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baateeka obumasukira bwa leediyo ku nfudu 14.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún so rẹ́díò-aṣamí mọ́ 14 nínú àwọn ìjàpá náà.
Zulu: Baphinde banamathisela ama-radio transmitters kwezingu-14 zezimfudu.
Hausa: Sun kuma maƙala wa kunkuru guda 14 na’urorin watsa siginar rediyo.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba kgokelela digatiši tša radio go dikhudu tše 14.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የሬዲዮ ማሰራጫዎችን በ14 ኤሊዎቹ ላይ አያይዘዋል።

English: These are small devices that allow researchers to track animal movements, and to monitor where they spend their time during the day and night.
Luganda: Buno buuma obutono obusobozesa abanoonyereza okulondoola entambula y’ensolo, wamu n’okulondoola ebifo we zimalira ebiseera byazo emisana n’ekiro.
Yoruba: Àwọn wọ̀nyí jẹ́ ohun-ìlò tí ó máa ń fún àwọn aṣèwádìí ní ààyè láti tọ ipasẹ ìrìn-ẹsẹ̀ ẹranko, àti láti mójútó ibi tí wọ́n ti ń lo àkókò wọn lójúmọmọ àti bí ilẹ̀ bá sú.
Zulu: Lawa amathuluzi amancane avumela abacwaningi ukuthi balandelele ukunyakaza kwezilwane, futhi baqaphe lapho echitha isikhathi sazo emini nasebusuku.
Hausa: Waɗannan ƙananan na’urori ne waɗanda suke ba masu bincike damar bin diddigin motsin dabbobi, da kuma lura da suke zama dare da rana.
Northern Sotho: Tšona ke ditlabelo tše nnyane tše di dumelelago banyakišiši go latišiša mesepelo ya diphoofolo, le go lekola fao di tšeago nako ya tšona mosegare le bošego.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች የእንስሳትን እንቅስቃሴ እና በቀን እና በሌሊት ጊዜያቸውን የት እንደሚያሳልፉ ለመከታተል የሚያስችሉ ትንንሽ መሳሪያዎች ናቸው።

English: The researchers then moved some of these tracked tortoises to a new area, so they could study them more easily.
Luganda: Olwo abanoonyereza ne baddira ezimu ku nfudu ezo ze baalondoola mu baziteeka mu kifo ekirala, basobole okuzekkaanya mu ngeri esingako obulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà wá kó díẹ̀ lára àwọn ìjàpá tí wọhn ń tọpasẹ̀ wọn lọ sí agbègbè tuntun, kí wọn ó lè ṣe ìwádìí lórí wọn lọ́nà tí ó gbà rọrùn síi.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebethuthela ezinye zalezi zimfudu ezilandelelwe endaweni entsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuzicwaninga kalula.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka matsar da wasu daga cikin waɗannan kunkuru da aka bi diddigin zuwa wani sabon wuri, domin su yi nazarinsu cikin sauƙi.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao banyakišiši ba ile ba tloša tše dingwe tša dikhudu tše di latišišwago go ya lefelong le leswa, gore ba kgona go di nyakišiša gabonolo kudu.
Amharic: ከዚያም በቀላሉ ለማጥናት እንዲያስችላቸው ተመራማሪዎቹ ከእነዚህ ክትትል የሚደረግባቸው ኤሊዎች ውስጥ አንዳንዶቹን ወደ አዲስ ቦታ አዘዋወሯቸው።

English: To the researchers’ surprise, however, two of the tortoises began heading back to their original territories, between 1 and 2.5 km away from where they’d been moved.
Luganda: Wabula ate ekyewuunyisa abanoonyereza kye kino, enfudu bbiri ku ezo zaatandika okubambaga nga zoolekera gye baaziggya, ebbanga eriri wakati wa kirommita 1 ne 2.5.
Yoruba: Ìyàlẹ́nu ni ó jẹ́ fún àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí, méjì nínú àwọn ìjàpá náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni kọrí sí ibi wọn gan-an, tí ó wà láàrin kìlómítà 1 sí 2.5 síbi tí wọ́n kó wọn lọ.
Zulu: Nokho, okwamangaza abacwaningi, izimfudu ezimbili zaqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zazo zakuqala, phakathi kwekhilomitha elingu-1 no-2.5 ​​ukusuka lapho babesusiwe.
Hausa: Amma ga mamakin masu binciken, biyu daga cikin kunkuru sun fara komawa yankunansu na asali, tsakanin kilomita 1 zuwa 2.5 daga inda aka kwashe su.
Northern Sotho: Seo se ilego sa makatša banyakišiši le ge go le bjale, tše pedi tša dikhudu di ile tša thoma go boela morago madulong a tšona a mathomong, ao a lego magareng ga dikhilometara ye 1 le tše 2.5 kgole le fao di išitšwego gona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ያስገረመው ነገር ግን ከኤሊዎቹ ውስጥ ሁለቱ ከተወሰዱበት ከ1 እስከ 2.5 ኪ.ሜ ባለው ርቀት ላይ ወደነበሩት ግዛቶቻቸው መመለስ ጀመሩ።

English: This was when the researchers decided to try moving more of the animals away from their homes, to see if they would show similar ‘homing’ behaviour.
Luganda: Kino kye kyaleetera abanoonyereza okusalawo okugezaako okuggya enfudu endala okuva we zaali zibeera, balabe oba nga zinaakola ekintu kye kimu ‘okudda eka’.
Yoruba: Ìgbà yìí ni àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí pinnu láti gbíyànjú kíkó díẹ̀ sí lára àwọn eranko wọ̀nyí kúrò nih ilé wọn, láti wò ó bóyá wọn yóò sàfihàn irúfẹ̀ ìwà ‘ìtọpasẹ̀-ilé’ náà.
Zulu: Kungaleso sikhathi lapho abacwaningi benquma ukuzama ukususa izilwane eziningi kude namakhaya abo, ukuze babone ukuthi bazobonisa yini ukuziphatha okufanayo 'kokuhomisa'.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne lokacin da masu binciken suka yanke shawarar yin ƙoƙari su matsar da yawa daga cikin dabbobin daga gidajensu, don ganin ko za su nuna irin wannan ɗabi'a ta 'gida'.
Northern Sotho: Se e bile ge banyakišiši ba tšea sephetho sa go tloša tše ntši tša diphoofolo tše go tloga magaeng a tšona, go bona ge eba le tšona di tla aletša maisthwaro ao a swanago a go ‘boela madulong’ a tšona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ተመሳሳይ 'ከፍልሰት የመመለስ' ባህሪ ያሳዩ እንደሆነ ለማየት ብዙ እንስሳትን ከመኖሪያቸው ለማንቀሳቀስ የወሰኑት ይሄን ጊዜ ነበር።

English: Interestingly, nearly half of the tortoises managed to find their way back to the exact same crevices they’d been living in before they were moved, often travelling more than 1.5 km to get there.
Luganda: Kyabeewuunyisa nti kumpi ekitundu ky’enfu kiraba ku ezo ze baatambuza zaasobola okuzuula ekkubo erizizza ewaka waazo mu njaziyazi gye zaali zibeera nga tezinnatambuzibwa, nga zitambula ebbanga erisukka ku kirommita 1.5 okutuukayo.
Yoruba: Óun tí ó dùnmọ́ni ni pé, ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó ìlàjì àwọn ìjàpá wọ̀nyí tí wọn tọpasẹ̀ ọ̀nà padà sí ààyè ibi tí wọhn ti ń gbé kí wọn ó tó kó wọn, tí wọ́n sì rin ìrìn-àjò tih ó tó kìlómítà 1.5 láti dé ibẹ̀.
Zulu: Bengihlala ngaphambi kokuthi bathuthwe, bevame ukuhamba ngaphezu kwe-1.5 km ukuya lapho.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa, kusan rabin kunkuru sun sami hanyar komawa zuwa ainihin ramukan da suke rayuwa a cikin kafin a komar da su, yawanci suna tafiya fiye da kilomita 1.5 domin isa wurin.
Northern Sotho: Sa go kgahliša ke gore, tekano ye e nyakilego go ba seripagare sa dikhudu di ile tša kgona go hwetša tsela ya tšona ya go boela morago go ya makgatheng a maswika fao di bego di dula gona mathomong pele ga ge di ka tlošwa, gomme gantši tša sepela dikhilometara tša go feta tše 1.5 go fihla fao.
Amharic: የሚገርመው ነገር፣ ከኤሊዎቹ ውስጥ ግማሽ ያህሉ ከመዛወራቸው በፊት ወደነበሩበት ተመሳሳይ ስንጥቆች መመለስ ችለዋል፣ ብዙ ጊዜ ወደዚያ ለመድረስ ከ1.5 ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ይጓዙ ነበር።

English: Another 15% of them managed to get back to the general area, but couldn’t find the crevice they’d originally been taken from.
Luganda: Ebitundu ebirala 15% eby’enfudu naybo byasobola okuddayo mu kitundu kyekimu, naye tezaasobola kuzuula kyaziyazi we baasooka kuziggya.
Yoruba: Ìdá 15% mìíràn náà tún tiraka láti padà dé agbègbè gbogbogbò, àmọ́ wọn kò lè sàwárí ààyè tí wọ́n ti kó wọn gan-an.
Zulu: Enye i-15% yazo ikwazile ukubuyela endaweni evamile, kodwa ayizange iwuthole umfantu eyayithathwe kuwo ekuqaleni.
Hausa: Wasu kashi 15% daga cikinsu sun sami damar matsarwa yankin gabaɗaya, amma sun kasa gano ramin da aka ɗauko su da farko.
Northern Sotho: 15% ye nngwe ya tšona e ile ya kgona go boela lefelong la tšona la madulo a kakaretšo, eupša ga se tša kgona go hwetša makgatheng a maswika tšeo di tšerwego gona mathomong.
Amharic: ሌሎች 15% የሚሆኑት ወደ አጠቃላይ አካባቢው መመለስ ችለዋል፣ ነገር ግን መጀመሪያ የተወሰዱበትን ስንጥቅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።

English: The researchers also found that different crevices usually had the same amount of tortoises resting in them, which suggests that the tortoises always use the same places to rest.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti ebyaziyazi eby’enjawulo kumpi byalinanga omuwendo gy’enfudu gwe gumu ogubeeramu, ekitegeeza nti enfudu zitera okukozesa ebifo byebimu okuwummuliramu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún ríi pé àwọn onírúnrú ààyè máa ń ní iye ìjàpá kan náà tí wọ́n ń simi nínú wọn, èyí tih ó dá a lábàá pé àwọn ìjàpá náà máà ń simi sí ààyè kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola nokuthi imifantu ehlukene ngokuvamile inenani elifanayo lezimfudu ezihlezi kuyo, okuphakamisa ukuthi. izimfudu zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo zokuphumula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa, ramuka daban-daban galibi suna da adadin kunkuru da suke hutawa a cikinsu, wanda hakan yake nuna cewa kullun suna amfani da wuraren hutawa iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gape gore makgathate a maswika ao a fapanego ka tlwaelo a be a na le tekano ye e lekanago ya dikhudu tšeo di khuditšego ka go ona, gomme se se šišinya gore dikhudu ka mehla di šomiša mafelo ao a swanago go khutša.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪም የተለያዩ ስንጥቆች በአብዛኛው ተመሳሳይ መጠን ያለው ዔሊዎች በውስጣቸው እንደሚያርፉ ያወቁ ሲሆን ይህም ኤሊዎቹ ለማረፍ ሁልጊዜ ተመሳሳይ ቦታዎችን እንደሚጠቀሙ ይጠቁማል።

English: The footage from the cameras also showed that male tortoises were territorial, meaning they’d fight other males trying to enter their territory or crevice.
Luganda: Ebifaananyi ebyakwatibwa ku kamera era byalaga nti enfudu ennume zaali zeefuga ebifo, ekitegeeza nti zaali zisobola okulwanyisa ennume endala ezaagezaako okuyingirira ebifo oba enjaziyazi zaazo.
Yoruba: Àwọn fídíò tí ó jẹyọ láti inú kámẹ́rà náà tún fi hàn pé àwọn akọ ìjàpá máa ń jẹ gàba ààyè, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé wọn yóò bá àwọn akọ mìíràn tí ó bá gbìyànjú lahti wọ ààyè wọn jà.
Zulu: Izithombe ezivela kumakhamera ziphinde zakhombisa ukuthi izimfudu zesilisa zaziyindawo, okusho ukuthi zazilwa nabanye abesilisa bezama ukungena endaweni yabo noma emifantwini.
Hausa: Hotunan na kyamarori sun kuma nuna cewa kunkuru maza mazauna yanki ne, ma’ana za su yi fada da wasu mazajen da suke ƙoƙarin shiga yankinsu ko raminsu.
Northern Sotho: Diswantšho tša go šutha tša ka khamereng le tšona di laeditše gore dikhudu tša dipholo di be di šireletša madulo a tšona, go rago gore di lwantšha dipholo tše dingwe ge di leka go tsena madulong a tšona goba ka makgatheng ao a maswika.
Amharic: የካሜራዎቹ ቀረጻም ወንድ ኤሊዎች ግዛታዊ መሆናቸውን አሳይቷል፣ ይህም ማለት ወደ ግዛታቸው ወይም ወደ ስንጥቃቸው ለመግባት የሚሞክሩ ሌሎች ወንዶችን ይፋለማሉ።

English: The researchers say that this is the first time that homing behaviour has been seen in pancake tortoises, and that their results show that these animals prefer to live and rest in the same places whenever they can.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti guno gwe mulundi ogwasookera ddala okulaba empisa y’okudda ewaka mu nfudu pancake, era nti ebyavaamu byalaga nti enfudu zino zisinga kwagala kubeera na kuwummulira mu bifo byebimu buli lwe zisobola.
Yoruba: Àwọn ṣèwádìí náà sọ pé èyí ni ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí ìwà ìtọpasẹ̀-ilé yóò di rírí lára àwọn ìjàpá abigbá-pẹrẹsẹ, àti ni àfikuhn pé àwọn èsì wọn ṣàfihàn pé ó tẹh àwọn eranko wọ̀nyí lọ́rùn lahti máa gbé àti lahti simi síbìkan náà ní gbogbo ìgbà tí ààyè rẹ̀ bá yọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi ukuziphatha kwe-homing kubonakale ezimfundweni zama-pancake, futhi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zithanda ukuhlala futhi ziphumule ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zikwazi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wannan shi ne karo na farko da ake ganin halin gida a cikin kunkuru mai faɗin baya, kuma sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa waɗannan dabbobin sun fi son zama da hutawa a wuri guda a duk lokacin da suka samu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore se ke la mathomo maistwharo a go boela madulong ga dikhudu go ile gwa bonwa ka go dikhudu tša pancake, le gore dipoelo tša tšona di laetša gore diphoofolo tše di rata go dula le go khutša mafelong ao a swanago nako efe le efe ge di kgona.
Amharic: በፓንኬክ ኤሊዎች ላይ ከፍልሰት የመመለስ ባህሪ ሲታይ ይህ የመጀመሪያው እንደሆነ እና ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው እነዚህ እንስሳት በቻሉት ልክ በአንድ ቦታ መኖር እና ማረፍ እንደሚመርጡ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: Their study didn’t explain how the tortoises were finding their way home, so future research should focus on understanding this important point.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwabwe tekwannyonnyola ngeri nfudu gye zaazuulamu kkubo lyazo kudda waka, kale okunoonyereza okujja mu maaso eyo kulina okusonga ku kutegeera ensonga eno enkulu.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí wọn kò sàlàyé bí àwọn ìjàpá náà se ń wá ọ̀nà padà sílé, fún ìdih èyí àwọn ìwádìí ọjọ́-iwájú gbọdọ̀ gbájú mọ́ níní ìmọ̀ nípa kókó pàtàkì yìí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi zazinjani izimfudu. ukuthola indlela eya ekhaya, ngakho ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli phuzu elibalulekile.
Hausa: Binciken nasu bai bayyana yadda kunkuru suke neman hanyarsu ta gida ba, domin haka ya kamata bincike na gaba ya mayar da hankali a kan fahimtar wannan muhimmin batu.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša bona ga se tša hlaloša ka fao dikhudu di ilego tša hwetša tsela ya tšona ya go boela gae, ka fao banyakišiši ba ka moso ba swanetše go nepiša dinyakišišo tša bona go kwešiša ntlha ye bohlokwa ye.
Amharic: ጥናታቸው ዔሊዎቹ ወደ መኖሪያቸው መመለሻ መንገዱን እንዴት እንደሚያገኙ አላብራራም፣ ስለዚህ የወደፊት ምርምር ይህንን አስፈላጊ ነጥብ በመረዳት ላይ ማተኮር አለበት።

English: Because animals sometimes need to be moved to new areas for conservation, this information would help conservationists to keep the tortoises safe in their new habitat.
Luganda: Olw’okuba nti ensolo olumu zeetaaga okutwalibwa mu kifo ekipya olw’okuzikuuma, obubaka buno buyinza okuyamba abakuumi b’ebisolo okukuuma enfudu nga teziriiko kabi mu kifo kyazo ekigya.
Yoruba: Nítorí nihgbà mìíràn wọ́n ní láti kó àwọn ẹranko kúrò lọ sí àwọn agbègbè tuntun fún ìdáàbòbò, àlàyé yìí yóò ran àwọn aṣèdáàbòbò lọ́wọ́ láti pa àwọn ìjàpá náà mọ́ ní ibùgbé wọn tuntun.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi izilwane ngezinye izikhathi kudingeka ziyiswe ezindaweni ezintsha ukuze zongiwe, lolu lwazi luzosiza abalondolozi bemvelo ukuthi bagcine izimfudu ziphephile endaweni yazo entsha.
Hausa: Domin a wasu lokuta ana buƙatar a koma da dabbobi zuwa sababbin wurare domin kiyayewa, wannan bayanin zai taimaka wa masu kiyayewa su kiyaye kunkuru a cikin sabon mazauninsu.
Northern Sotho: Ka gobane diphoofolo ka dinako tše dingwe di swanetše go išwa mafelong a maswa a go di babalela, tshedimošo ye e tla thuša bašomi ba pabalelo ya tlhago go dira gore dikhudu di dule di bolokegile ka madulong a tšona a maswa.
Amharic: እንስሳት አንዳንድ ጊዜ ለጥበቃ ሲባል ወደ አዲስ አካባቢዎች መወሰድ ስላለባቸው፣ ይህ መረጃ የጥበቃ ባለሙያዎች ዔሊዎቹ በአዲሱ መኖሪያቸው ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ለማድረግ ይረዳቸዋል።

English: The study was a collaboration between scientists from Kenya and China, and adds to our knowledge of homing behaviour in tortoises and other animals.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa mu mukago wakati wa bannassaayansi okuva mu Kenya ne China, era kwongera ku kumanya kwaffe ku bikwata ku mpisa z’okudda ewaka mu nfudu n’ensolo endala.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà jẹ́ àjọṣepọ̀ láàrin àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì láti ilẹ̀ Kenya àti China, ó sì se àlékún ìmọ̀ wa nípa ìwà ìtọpasẹ̀-ilé lára àwọn ìjàpá àti àwọn eranko yòókù.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo bekuwukusebenzelana phakathi kososayensi baseKenya naseChina, futhi lwengeza olwazini lwethu ngokuziphatha kwezimfudu nezinye izilwane.
Hausa: Binciken haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga ƙasashen Kenya da kuma Sin, , kuma ya ƙara wa iliminmu game da halin gida a cikin kunkuru da sauran dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše e bile tirišano magareng ga bašomi ba tša mahlale go tšwa ka Kenya le China, ebile di tsenya letsogo go tsebo ya rena ya maitshwaro ka go boela morago magaeng ka dikhudu le ka diphoofolo tše dingwe.
